addresses.overviewHTML: H5 Data Centers 21800 Beaumeade Cir 20147 Ashburn Virginia, USA 5's Ashburn Data Center is a Powered Shell Adjacent to Capitol of Northern Virginia Peering Center H5's Ashburn data center is a 70,000 square-foot powered shell located on a 5-acre parcel of land adjacent to one of the world's largest data center clusters. The Ashburn data center represents a unique opportunity to build up to 20 MWs of critical load next to the world's largest Internet peering hubs. The 70,000 SF powered shell is easily expandable to 108,000 SF and has immediate access of 8.5 MVA from Dominion Power. Access to such power allows a faster time to market. The Ashburn data center's ceiling heights are more than 20 feet and floor loads can exceed 200 lbs. per SF. H5's Ashburn data center offers the ability to customize security, data center layouts, and mechanical designs - all next to one of the most densely interconnected locations in the world. H5 is offering the unique opportunity to enter into a capital lease for the entire Ashburn data center for self-performed construction and management or engage with H5 for a wholesale turn-key data center. Capital leases enable increased EBITDA and lower upfront cash payments. Conveniently located in Ashburn's data center cluster, H5's Ashburn data center is in close proximity to Dulles International Airport and highways. Join the growing list of companies that choose an H5-managed powered shell that provides design and operations flexibility as well as the ability to reduce operating expenses and depreciate a capital investment. Unique aspects of the Ashburn data center include: Ashburn Data Center 70,000 SF expandable to over 108,000 SF Ability to support up to 20 MWs of critical load Customized, private data center suite opportunities Faster time to market than greenfield construction Available office, staging, storage and conference room space Single-story structure with ample on-site parking 20-foot ceiling heights with spacious columns Over 200 lbs./SF floor loading Loading dock access for 18-wheelers Capital lease options Self-perform construction or build-to-suit with H5's experts Ability to support more than 2,000 cabinets Corporate branding opportunities on Beaumeade Circle Power Dominion Power can provide the Ashburn data center with up to 30 MWs of reliable and affordable power (average annual costs per kWh of less than $0.065). Utility power can be delivered diverse substations. 8.5 MVA from Dominion Power is available immediately. In addition to aggressive Virginia state tax incentives, H5 qualifies for 'new entrant' power pricing discounts from Dominion Power that can significantly reduce power bills. Electrical and mechanical highlights include: Utility feeds from Dominion Power's high capacity, modern power grid Flexible tier design - build data center infrastructure according to specific uptime requirements Ability for customer customization of temperature and humidity controls, including 100% outside air capability Less than $0.065/kwh avg. annual power pricing from Dominion Power Security The Ashburn data center can be built-out to the strictest security parameters to ensure regulatory compliance. The data center offers the ability to construct the following security benefits: Mantraps Biometric and key card access controls Perimeter fencing Dedicated fire suppression system Early smoke detection system SSAE SOC 1 Type II certification Corporate-wide ISO 27001 compliance Easy PCI compliance Network H5's Ashburn data center offers carrier-neutral data center services, providing customers with access to a variety of different regional, national and international telecommunications carriers and fiber providers. Nearly every facilities-based fiber provider in Northern Virginia has routes directly adjacent to the data center on Beaumeade Circle, en route to the Equinix Ashburn data center campus. Carriers can access H5's Ashburn data center via multiple, diverse manholes. Highlights of H5's Ashburn network-neutral data center include: Access to the region's top metro fiber and communications providers Over 15 metro fiber providers have fiber next to the data center Diverse fiber points of entry Close proximity to the largest peering hub in the world

addresses.overviewHTML: DataBank 21635 Red Rum Drive 20147 Ashburn Virginia, USA Agile and Flexible IT Infrastructure Management While the large, unwieldy datacenter colocation providers are often too slow moving to adapt to changing customer needs and small, newer entrants lack the financial resources and scalable infrastructure, Latisys will provide customers of the Ashburn, Virginia facility with a hands-on experience that is flexible, agile and immediately responsive to an enterprise’s specific needs. Managed Services Our Managed Services are tailored to relieve increasingly burdened IT staff from their many routine, non-revenue generating tasks. Clients choose to utilize our fully integrated managed service solutions to balance workload, fill server and infrastructure knowledge gaps, outsource critical server, storage, security and network solutions and supplement existing systems and resources. State-of-the-Art Security To protect your mission-critical operations, Latisys maintains a tight and multi-layered security system. A digital video surveillance network monitors and records all data center area and building entrance activity. Data center floor entrances are controlled by strictly managed access levels, man-trap entry and biometric scans to ensure that only your authorized personnel are allowed entry. In addition to the physical security features, our highly secure NOC features 100% uptime and is manned 24x7x365 by our rapid response specialists. All detected issues are proactively tracked and acted upon for immediate resolution.

addresses.overviewHTML: The BlackChamber Group Pacific Blvd / Wapool Rd 20166 Ashburn Virginia, USA The Dulles 28 Technology Park is a significant data center development project undertaken by The BlackChamber Group, a private equity firm based in Washington, D.C. The Tech Park at Brambleton, located in Loudoun County, represents one of several projects aimed at bolstering the region's infrastructure to meet the growing demand for data center services. Their expertise is drawn from former executives of Corporate Office Properties Trust and other industry veterans with backgrounds in investment banking and data center site selection for major tech firms.

addresses.name: 19886 Ashburn Rd
addresses.overviewHTML: JK Land Holdings 19886 Ashburn Rd 20147 Ashburn Virginia, USA The proposed data center in Loudoun County, covering 25 acres, represents a significant investment with its recent purchase for $60 million. The site, currently utilized by Telos Corporation, was sold by Finmarc Management Inc., which had acquired it in 2019 for $26.1 million. JK Land Holdings, owned by Chuck Kuhn, is contemplating the development of a data center at this location on Ashburn Road. Although the future of the site post-Telos' lease is not set in stone, a data center remains a strong possibility. The plan includes a two-story data center spanning 360,000 square feet, complemented by a substation, pending the relocation of the existing headquarters and parking facilities. This plan received county approval and was initially proposed by Finmarc in February 2023. Currently, the site houses a three-story commercial office building and a single-story industrial building, totaling 190,000 square feet of space, which serves as Telos Corporation's headquarters. Telos is expected to maintain its tenancy until 2029, continuing a long-standing presence since 1988.

addresses.overviewHTML: AVAIO Digital within north of the town of Appomattox, VA 24522 Appomattox Virginia, USA The exact location of this data center is not public, but it is located within north of the town of Appomattox, VA The AVAIO Appomattox Campus is a groundbreaking hyperscale data center project located in Appomattox County, Virginia. This ambitious development spans 452 acres and represents a significant investment of $3 billion. The campus is designed to meet the growing demands of cloud service providers (CSPs) and high-performance computing (HPC) and AI data centers. The Appomattox Campus will feature a substantial power capacity of 300 megawatts, confirmed from CVEC and Dominion. Strategically positioned atop major long-haul fiber lines with direct links to key hubs, the site is fully zoned for data centers and ready for rapid construction. The project emphasizes sustainability, incorporating substantial onsite green power generation to align with the increasing demand for environmentally responsible digital infrastructure. This development is expected to bring significant economic benefits to the region, including the creation of high-tech jobs and substantial investment in the local economy. The Appomattox Data Hub exemplifies AVAIO Digital's strategy of expanding Virginia's thriving data center industry beyond traditional hubs, bringing opportunities for economic growth and diversification across the Commonwealth.

addresses.overviewHTML: Chirisa within directly adjacent to CTP’s existing Richmond technology campus 23836 Chester Virginia, USA The exact location of this data center is not public, but it is located within directly adjacent to CTP’s existing Richmond technology campus Chirisa Technology Parks, in partnership with AREP-owned PowerHouse Data Centers, has recently expanded its technological footprint with the acquisition of 104 acres in Chesterfield County. This strategic purchase lies adjacent to CTP's current tech campus, setting the stage for significant development. The new site, aptly named Digital Drive, is poised to become a hub for advanced technology with plans for five AI-ready facilities. These facilities will encompass over 600,000 square feet of space and boast an initial energy capacity of 300MW, courtesy of a substation currently under construction. With an ambitious vision, the companies aim to enhance Digital Drive's capacity beyond 1GW. The first of these state-of-the-art facilities is slated for completion in 2026, with the entire campus expected to be operational by 2028.

addresses.name: Globalinx Virginia Beach
addresses.overviewHTML: Globalinx 1650 Corporate Landing Pkwy 23454 Virginia Beach Virginia, USA The Globalinx Data Centers campus, located in the Corporate Landing Business Park of Virginia Beach, represents a pioneering step in the evolution of global connectivity. This state-of-the-art facility is a hub for international data flow, offering a unique carrier-neutral colocation environment. It stands out as a strategic meet-me point for subsea and terrestrial fiber, providing a critical link between four continents: North America, South America, Europe, and Africa. The campus boasts direct access to the MAREA and BRUSA subsea cables, which connect Virginia Beach with Spain, Puerto Rico, and Brazil, respectively. Designed to Tier III data center standards, the campus ensures high security with a fortified perimeter and operates above the 500-year flood zone, ensuring resilience against natural disasters. With its progressive design, the campus offers multi-phase expansion capability, catering to private and autonomous data suites tailored to tenant's space requirements. The Globalinx Data Centers campus is not just a data center; it's a gateway to the world, facilitating high-speed, secure, and efficient data transmission across the globe.

WDC1 is LEED Gold certified and DOD- and DCID compliant and measures approximately 230,000 square feet (gross space) and will be phased into service. This innovative data center features a unique two level design that places the 100,000 square feet of raised floor space on the second level with the accompanying equipment directly beneath it on the first level, creating significant efficiencies as well as the ability to increase critical power to keep pace with market demand for more densely powered space. Full critical load is expected to be up to 30 megawatts. New!  Connect to LINX NoVa in WDC1: http://www.evoswitch.com/sites/default/files/imports/WDC1-fact-sheet-English-April-2013.pdf

addresses.overviewHTML: Amazon AWS Dumfries Rd & Colchester Park Dr 20112 Manassas Virginia, USA In Virginia's Prince William County, a company with ties to Amazon has secured a significant tract of land. Minnieville Capital Acquisitions LLC, known for assembling and entitling land for data center use, has purchased approximately 39 acres for $56.6 million. Although Minnieville is the listed buyer, there are indications that the actual purchaser has connections to Amazon, as suggested by property records linking to a Seattle address commonly associated with the tech giant. The land is poised to become part of the expansive Mid-County Industrial Park project, which includes plans for up to 64 data centers. The Prince William Board of County Supervisors has already given the green light for rezoning in support of this development. According to projections, this particular site could accommodate up to three data centers, aligning with Amazon's strategy of expanding based on customer demand.

addresses.name: Superb DCA2 - McLean
addresses.overviewHTML: HopOne Internet 8201 Greensboro Dr 22102 McLean Virginia, USA DCA2 Data Center is located in Virginia's prestigious Tyson's Corner (McLean). It is 13,000+ sq. ft. in size, has over 10 Gb/s traffic capacity, and is staffed 24x7x365 with nearly 20 highly-skilled staff on site. The location has been carefully picked as one of the highest elevation (well above the 100-year flood plane) and most reliable power areas in all of Virginia. Power Generators: The data centre is fed via three separate power feeds and is protected by two separate generators, and further secured in case of any generator failure via three separate roll-up generator connection points. AC Infrastructure: A modern data centre requires over 30 tons of cooling per each 1000 sq. ft. Our DCA2 data centre has ample cooling - designed and engineered with the capacity and redundancy in place to keep the current and future generations of (even more dense and hotter) servers cool. Outside condensers are located in two separate areas. Security: The data centre is secured via multiple perimeter access systems, fire-proof heavy-duty doors, and is equipped with 24x7x365 live video surveillance, and multiple level independent fire-suppression systems, in addition to being, of course, always staffed 24x7x365. Network: DCA2 is an integral part of the HopOne.net national coast-to-coast IP backbone. Multiple Gigabits per second of traffic continuously stream out of and into DCA2, all through a fully redundant Cisco 12012 GSR series based core network architecture, linking DCA2 to the world. AC & Access to Distribution Network Infrastructure: The data centre floor is dotted with numerous 30 ton Liebert AC units, two of which are seen here. Due to the size of the data centre, in certain areas "Distribution layer C" switches are in place to aggregate the (as always, fully redundant in every single way) Distrition B to Access layer links. Data Centre floor Power Architecture: Numerous PDU units also dot the data centre floor, distributing the power to the power-hungry servers occupying the racks and shelves throughout. Power Protection Infrastructure: The data centre uses three (3) separate UPS systems, one on each separate power feed. UPS systems, via two separate power feeds, and being backed up by two separate generators, switched in nanoseconds between the sources using via the intelligent STS. Critical power loads, such as the core network routers, are protected in real time via an advanced Static Transfer Switch (STS), that ensures that they remain up even in a catastrophic failure of one UPS system and a generator - by being fed from two separate The data centre is staffed live 24x7x365 by highly skilled systems & network engineers and administrators. All clients can always talk directly to a technician locally on site at any time of the day or night.

addresses.name: NetEx NDC01
addresses.overviewHTML: NetEx Inc. 8460 Tyco Road 22182 Vienna Virginia, USA Data Centers & Security: NetEx is committed to the highest level of security, from your servers to our data centers.  We offer a three-tiered encryption process that delivers the maximum level of data backup protection available. Our datacenter facilities are SSAE-16 compliant to control and safeguard the most sensitive of data sets. Our data center facilities features include security with biometric credentials, advanced fire suppression, multi-node cooling system, 24/7 monitoring, temperature/humidity control, and N +1 infrastructure for redundancy. Data Backup and Compliance: NetEx Cloud Backup and data centers meet the needs of the most demanding client verticals. Our security features meet the stringent compliance needs of financial services, healthcare, legal, retail industries and more. NetEx is able to implement a disaster recovery solution that requires your mission critical data always be available. Backup Microsoft SQL databases, Exchange databases, Windows Server file servers, VMWare, Linux, and workstations. •    HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) •    SSAE-16 (Sarbanes-Oxley) •    PCI (Payment Card Industry) NetEx Vault platform offers secure file transfers, unlike other file collaboration services, NetEx Vault protects data by encrypting it locally, in-transit and again in the cloud. This means the data is stored with two layers of encryption – one controlled by NetEx Vault, and one controlled by the user. Other web-based file sharing services send private files to the cloud in their raw, open format- portraying private data as safe when it arrives in their cloud. The Vantage VA11 data center has received multiple awards: - 2019 Best of NAIOP Northern Virginia Awards, Award of Excellence - 2020 Northern Virginia Technology Council (NVTC) Data Center Awards, Finalist, Data Center Construction Project Power: - Power provided by Dominion Energy, the leading energy provider in the region - Multiple, diverse power feeds supporting the campus - 480V end-to-end electrical distribution Cooling: - Computer Room Air Handling (CRAH) units located in two galleries on opposite sides of each data module allow for highly efficient airflow distribution - Closed-loop chilled water system with air-side economizers - N+2 redundancy across all mechanical systems - Water Utilization Efficiency (WUE) is near zero (liters/kW/hr) using the latest cooling design Connectivity: - All major fiber-based service providers operating within two miles of the Vantage campus - Multiple Meet-Me-Rooms (MMRs) throughout the campus, allowing for diverse paths and multiple connectivity options - Four points-of-entry (POEs) for the campus ensuring maximum path diversity for inbound carriers - Diverse fiber pathways into the data center campus (minimum 2 paths per carrier) Security: - On-site security operations center with patrols 24x7x365 - Perimeter security gates and fencing - CCTV on all access control points throughout the entire campus - Dual authentication (access badge/PIN and biometric readers) for customer and critical infrastructure areas - Visitor management system and badging to control and track onsite personnel all the time

Located under a mile from QTS' Vault campus in Dulles and Ashburn campus, the site provides significant potential capacity to support QTS' ongoing growth in the nation's largest and fastest growing Tier 1 data center market. Located in the single largest data center market in North America and one of the top five markets in the world, our campus is ideal for growing companies looking for a home in one of the nation's most desirable markets. Through its software-defined technology platform, QTS is able to deliver secure, compliant infrastructure solutions, robust connectivity and premium customer service to more than 1,100 leading Hyperscale technology companies, enterprises, and government entities. It is this level of experience and proven track record that sets QTS apart from the rest of the industry.

addresses.name: Rockbridge Area Network Authority - RAP Data Center
addresses.overviewHTML: Rockbridge Area Network Authority 150 S Main Street 24450 Lexington Virginia, USA The Rockbridge Area Network Authority's RAP Data Center is a purpose-built, dedicated Tier 2 Data and Colocation facility located on the outskirts of the City of Lexington in Rockbridge County, VA. The Rockbridge Area Network Authority (RANA) is a public authority that operates the RAP Data Center as well as the area-wide fiber optic network that was funded utilizing a federal BTOP grant and began service in 2014. Businesses, universities, local governments as well as domestic and international carriers have all found a home for colocation service in our carrier-neutral RAP data center. The RAP Data Center is nestled at the crossroads of Interstate 81 and 64 in Rockbridge County and offers unparalleled access to major U.S. markets, with over 65% of the U.S. population and 200,000 manufacturers within a 500-mile radius. Our location’s proximity to Virginia's ports and airports makes it ideal for local and international businesses. The Rockbridge area’s economy is diversified, with a strong focus on manufacturing, trade, services, and agriculture. Three small universities are also located in the area. From textiles to industrial goods, Rockbridge County's manufacturing sector thrives on natural resources. Its bustling trade networks and vibrant service industry enrich the region's economic landscape, while agriculture remains a vital cornerstone of its rural heritage. The RAP Data Center offers full cabinets, portions of a cabinet, and separate cage space for colocation customers. We are here to meet your current colocation needs and beyond. RAP Data Center Features • 12,400 square feet raised floor with a design power load of 100kVA. • Two 100kVA UPS systems and a 350-kW standby generator to ensure your equipment keeps running in the event of a power outage in the area. • Power delivered on the floor by dual power distribution units so that each cabinet has power supplied by an A and B bus. • Three 20-ton CRAC air handlers supply cool air to the floor. For redundancy, two of the CRACs can cool the floor at design load. • Inert gas suppression fire systems protect the raised floor and a separate electrical room. • We provide a dark facility with remote monitoring and video surveillance inside and out. •Limited Remote Hands on a case-by-case basis. Please consider joining us at the RAP Data Center. For more information contact us at: Note: (Mailing address only) Rockbridge Area Network Authority Richard A. Peterson (RAP) Data Center 150 S. Main Street Lexington, VA 24450 540.464.9990 ranabroadband@gmail.com https://www.ranabroadband.net/colocation

addresses.name: John Marshall Commons Tech Park
addresses.overviewHTML: The BlackChamber Group Catharpin Road / John Marshall 20155 Gainesville Virginia, USA The John Marshall Commons Tech Park is a significant development project undertaken by The BlackChamber Group, a private equity firm based in Washington, D.C. This project represents a strategic expansion of the company's data center portfolio in Northern Virginia, a region that has become a hub for data center activity due to its robust infrastructure and proximity to major network exchange points. On December 15, 2021, The BlackChamber Group, through the entity CTP-II LLC, acquired 22.5 acres of land at the intersection of John Marshall Highway (Route 55) and Catharpin Road in Gainesville, Virginia. The purchase price of $16.4 million reflects the strategic value of the location, inferring a valuation of $730k per acre. The BlackChamber Group's approach to data center development focuses on creating single-tenant data center powered shells, which are then leased to hyperscale technology companies under long-term, triple-net leases. The firm's strategy includes the eventual sale of these data center shell assets, once leased, at prices that reflect their intrinsic value, targeting cap rates of less than or equal to 4%. The leadership team at The BlackChamber Group brings a wealth of experience from the data center sector. Key members have held significant positions at Corporate Office Properties Trust (COPT), a real estate investment trust specializing in data center properties, and other notable financial and technology firms. This collective expertise underpins the firm's ambitious development projects in the data center domain.

The flexible design and enhanced power and cooling capacity offers a state-of-the-art facility that meets the demands of customers with the most stringent security requirements. QTS's trained staff includes facility and electrical maintenance engineers, data center operations experts, network architects and security officers committed to providing on-site 24x7x365 support and operations for our facilities. addresses.overviewHTML: DataBank 14601 Germanna Hwy 22701 Culpeper Virginia, USA IAD5 stands as a pioneering facility within the DataBank Culpeper Campus, marking its significance as the first of three data centers within this innovative complex. Designed to cater to the most demanding workloads, IAD5 is equipped with a High-Performance Computing (HPC)-ready "Universal Data Hall Design". This design is meticulously crafted to provide optimal power and cooling solutions, ensuring the efficient handling of enterprise, hyperscale, and artificial intelligence applications. The data center boasts an impressive 180,000 square feet of raised floor space and a substantial 40MW critical IT load capacity. This robust infrastructure is complemented by an N+1 power design and diverse power configurations, including 120/208V and 240/415V AC power options. The cooling system is equally resilient, featuring an N+1 cooling design capable of supporting both air and liquid cooling solutions for cabinet densities exceeding 30kW and 100kW, respectively. Interconnectivity is a cornerstone of IAD5, with the presence of onsite carriers facilitating managed internet connectivity. The data center's architecture supports a range of colocation options, from cabinets to cages, all within a framework that guarantees 100% uptime service level agreements (SLAs). The operational excellence of IAD5 is further ensured by 24/7/365 access to remote hands and special request smart hands services, providing clients with uninterrupted support and peace of mind.

addresses.name: OnePartner ATAC
addresses.overviewHTML: OnePartner, LLC. 158 Advanced Technology Drive 24244 Duffield Virginia, USA On October 2, 2008, OnePartner officially launched the Advanced Technology & Applications Center (ATAC) in Duffield, Virginia.  The measure of Data Center resiliency (availability) is called the “Tier rating system”.  These standards are administered by The Uptime Institute (http://uptimeinstitute.org). Tier I Tier I is composed of a single path for power and cooling distribution, without redundant components (99.671% availability). Tier II Tier II is composed of a single path for power and cooling distribution, with redundant components (99.741% availability). Tier III Tier III is composed of multiple active power and cooling distribution paths, but only one path active, has redundant components, and is Concurrently Maintainable (99.982% availability). Tier IV Tier IV: composed of multiple active power and cooling distribution paths, has redundant components, and is fault tolerant (99.995% availability). The Uptime Institute exclusively contracts ComputerSite Engineering to conduct thorough reviews of a data center for the certification process.  Other data center’s Tier claims, without the Certification, are without merit, leaving their clients at risk. _______ A quote from the Certification Manager… “The OnePartner ATAC in Duffield, Virginia is currently the sole U.S. company providing outsourced commercial data center services (including colocation and disaster recovery) that has been awarded a Tier III Design Certification by the Uptime Institute.” - Julian Kudritzki, Certification Manager ComputerSite Engineering & The Uptime Institute There are no Certified Tier IV commercial facilities, thus the OnePartner ATAC has the highest commercial Certification. _______ We are looking for clients who take their responsibilities very seriously.  We believe those companies will want to reserve space in the OnePartner ATAC. View a photo tour of the ATAC online at http://www.onepartner.com. Space is limited. addresses.name: Hivelocity - Dallas 1
addresses.overviewHTML: Hivelocity 1515 Round Table Dr 75247 Dallas Texas, USA Hivelocity was founded in 2002 by a few guys with a single mission to create an exceptional company with a singular focus on simplifying hosting. Starting with a single rack of servers located in the quintessential basement, (every great start-up story starts in a basement or garage after all) our vision was to build a hosting company that not only supported customer growth but fostered it as well. Our philosophy back in 2002 is the same as it is today, the more successful our customers are the more successful we will be. Hivelocity's goal has always been to do whatever possible, whenever possible to put our customers in the best position to succeed, with the simple hope that our customer's success would eventually lead to them needing more of our services. Our deliberate effort to focus only on the customer's needs and success has led us from the single rack of servers in that dingy basement to operating 8 world-class data centers totaling over 70,000 square feet across Florida, Georgia, New York, Texas, California, and Washington State. Today we maintain and manage over 15,000 physical and virtualized servers and provide managed solutions on dedicated servers, virtual servers and private cloud. Each of our data centers is SSAE-16 SOC1 and SOC2 certified with HIPAA and PCI compliant services also available. Hivelocity is privately held and currently employs 80 of the brightest technicians, engineers and programmers in the business. Through all of the growth and all of the added service offerings our mission has never changed provide our customers with a solution and environment that puts them in the best position to succeed. To us this means providing incredibly reliable solutions that allow our customers to focus on running their business. It means providing a level of customer service and support that far exceeds their expectations. It means always considering the customer's user experience first in everything we do and offer. Lastly, it means doing all of these things at a price point that enables their businesses to flourish. To provide the ultimate user experience through exceptional customer service, flawless reliability and extraordinary innovation. Today and always.

addresses.name: EdgeConneX Houston
addresses.overviewHTML: EdgeConneX 1510 Prime West Parkway 77449 Katy Texas, USA StratITsphere, a technology services company based in the Houston area, invested $15 million to renovate a warehouse in Katy into a new company headquarters and state-of-the-art data center. And that’s just the first phase of the project the company unveiled today. “Texas, especially in the Houston area, has a robust economy and a great environment for business,” said Stephen Webster, president and CEO of StratITsphere. “This is the right time and the right place to invest in the future.” The company will move from its offices in Humble to the 94,000-square-foot facility at 1510 Primewest Parkway in January. StratITsphere plans to invest additional millions to build out the facility over the next five years. The first phase of development will create 10 jobs in 2011 with an annual payroll of $1 million, Webster said. The employee base will grow to 35 during the next five years. The building represents the highest quality of data center that can be built. A data center provides a secure off-site location for companies to store their most important computer equipment and data, Webster said. The site offers 24-hour manned security and advanced physical safeguards like video surveillance equipment and biometric locks to keep equipment and data secure, he said. In the event of an emergency, the site has generators, showers, kitchens and other amenities that allow it to operate independently from the outside world for up to six days. It also has multiple internet connections to guarantee clients can access their systems and data and keep their businesses open. “If you have to evacuate for a hurricane and your systems are in our facility, you can run your business by pulling into a Starbucks and opening up your laptop,” Webster explained. Clients also can set up shop or camp out in data center if their respective offices are unusable. Most companies can’t afford or justify the expense to build and maintain such facilities on their own, so there is great demand to rent space from firms like StratITsphere, Webster said. Nationally, demand for such services is outpacing available supply by a 3-1 ratio. Along with the data center, StratITsphere offers IT infrastructure and security consulting to Fortune 500 companies, including many energy companies based in Houston. “Most companies don’t get the full benefit from the millions of dollars they spend on computers and technology because they don’t know exactly what they should buy, or they don’t know how to use all the capabilities they’ve purchased,” Webster said. “We help them on both counts, and help them secure their systems so a low-level employee can’t post company secrets on WikiLeaks.”

CloudBurst Central Texas stands as a beacon of innovation and sustainability in the heart of Central Texas. This flagship data center, nestled on a sprawling 75-acre site between Austin and San Antonio, is designed to be a Next-Gen, Net-Zero facility with an initial capacity of 20MW, scalable to 30MW. The region's abundant sunshine, geological stability, and favorable climate make it an ideal location for this cutting-edge development. The facility is powered by a robust 100MW solar energy infrastructure, featuring a Next-Gen solar farm located adjacent to the data center and several additional 10MW solar farms distributed locally. addresses.name: GTT Austin Data Center
addresses.overviewHTML: GTT Communications 6200 Bridgepoint Parkway 78730 Austin Texas, USA About One Source Networks: One Source Networks is a leading provider of innovative, purpose-built communications solutions for the Fortune 1000. Delivering ubiquitous access to cloud-based voice, video, security and computing applications, as well as enterprise networking and infrastructure services, the company offers customizable, cost-effective and scalable solutions delivered on its fully redundant global network infrastructure with interconnection to over 200 global suppliers. The OSN difference is simplicity, cost reduction and customer service focus that delivers all solutions under one contract, one team and one invoice. One Source Networks is a two-time winner of the Inc. 500 award which highlights America´´´€š´´´€ž´s fastest-growing private companies. About Austin Data Center: The One Source Networks´´´€š´´´€ž´ 10,000 square foot data center in Austin, Texas is designed to grow with your business, with a range of offerings that include colocation, cloud computing, unified communications, managed servers, storage, load balancing and firewalls. The facility houses both customer and OSN infrastructure and is well-equipped to meet unique requirements, whether you are seeking a single service, management and solution design, or complete outsourcing of your IT functions. Our Austin facility is SSAE16 Type II certified and PCI compliant, and was built to meet or exceed commercial telecommunications standards worldwide for availability, integrity, and confidentiality. Our on-site 24/7 NOC and top tier engineering team deliver world-class support to enterprises worldwide. Our engineers specialize in assessing, designing, implementing, and managing complex systems, with an emphasis on disaster preparedness and high availability. Engineers maintain core certifications in Cisco security and networking, IP Telephony, Microsoft, CommVault´ data management solutions, VMware virtualization and Dell Enterprise Storage, along with expertise and certifications in a host of supporting products and technologies. Our Austin data center features conditioned, continuous power systems that provide multiple power phases with separate Power Distribution Units (PDUs) and N+1 Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPSs) per phase. The facility is equipped with a 1.5 megawatt utility feed from Austin Energy that may be upgraded based upon customer requirements. Emergency power generation systems provide auxiliary power and can support the entire facility at maximum load for at least 24 hours with fuel stored on-site and refueling contracts with multiple providers to ensure uninterrupted emergency power regardless of widespread, lengthy outages. Electrical power is delivered via 110 volt or 220 volt circuits, and in 20 or 30 amp flow rates. The Austin facility has two separate fiber entry points, so if a connection fails, neither the user experience nor the service performance will be impacted. This redundancy ensures reliable connectivity with no data transmission bottlenecks to or from the data center. The facility offers access to four diverse fiber providers including multiple Tier 1 Internet networks. Network connectivity is delivered to customers via multiple Ethernet access feeds to allow for redundancy. The data center cooling system consists of 100 tons of Liebert downflow cooling units, expandable to 300 tons, providing N+1 cooling capacity across the data center. All of the Computer Room Air Conditioning equipment is designed to support high-end server equipment. Steamgenerating humidifiers and electric reheat coils control humidity, and modern Chatsworth server racks force hot air directly into the overhead plenum, virtually eliminating hot spots. The facility has a raised flooring system for enhanced air flow. Our data center is staffed 24/7 and secured by multiple badge access doors. Only authorized OSN engineering and technical staff are allowed in the data center core and cloud services hosting areas, while customer access to the colocation areas is secured by badge and administered by our NOC staff. The data center is under 24/7 video surveillance and physical access and equipment ingress and egress are logged. The Austin facility has a double-interlocked pre-action fire protection system designed to provide the best possible security against accidental discharge of water from the sprinklers. Water will discharge from a sprinkler only if that sprinkler has been subjected to enough heat to melt the fusible link on the water head.

All Zayos colocation data centers were acquired by DataBank in 2020. ACT1 Waco Data Center is a repurposed Cold War nuclear fall-out shelter, providing physical security previously unmet in the commercially available data center market.  It’s Central Texas location is within a 100-mile radius from Dallas, Austin, Houston and San Antonio, allowing for true data replication between the W-ITG and clients in those cities. It incorporates dual transformer commercial power feeds and multi-carrier fiber availability for operating capacity and redundancy.  The facility features a layered security protocol that includes biometrics, magnetic key cards, DVR cameras and onsite personnel.  An 80-space parking lot has been converted to support mobile work-space recovery vehicles in the event employees are displaced from their daily work environments.

addresses.overviewHTML: Colocation America 707 Wilshire Blvd Suite 400 90017 Los Angeles California, USA The Aon Center is a modernist office skyscraper located at 707 Wilshire Boulevard in downtown Los Angeles, California. Completed in 1973, it is the second-tallest building in Los Angeles at 858 feet (262 meters) high, and has 62 floors. Designed by Charles Luckman, it is a rectangular black building with a white border, and a remarkably slender form for a skyscraper in a seismically-active area. The logo of the Aon Corporation, its primary tenant, is at the top in red. It was originally called the United California Bank Building from its completion in 1973 until 1984, when it became known as the First Interstate Tower. When built, it was the tallest building west of the Mississippi River, until surpassed by the Texas Commerce Tower in 1982. It remained the tallest building in Los Angeles until 1989 when the Library Tower (now the U.S. Bank Tower) was completed. Between 1998 and 2003, there were no logos on the building. On May 4, 1988, a fire that began in the 12th floor just after 10:00 PM PST burned for four hours, destroyed five floors, injured 40 people, and left one maintenance worker dead. The fire was severe because workers had disconnected the pipes that fed the fire sprinkler system, which was under construction at the time. The fire was eventually contained at 2:19 AM. The fire caused $50 million in damages, and it took four months to repair the building. Also, because of the fire, Los Angeles building codes were changed, requiring all high-rises to be equipped with fire sprinklers. This modified a 1974 ordinance that only required new buildings to contain fire sprinkler systems.

addresses.overviewHTML: Shorenstein 707 Wilshire Boulevard 90017 Los Angeles California, USA The Aon Center, located at 707 Wilshire Boulevard in downtown Los Angeles, is a striking 62-story skyscraper that stands 858 feet tall. Designed by Charles Luckman, this modernist office building was completed in 1973. Its sleek, rectangular design, featuring a bronze-clad exterior with white trim, makes it one of the most recognizable buildings in the city. Originally known as the United California Bank Building, the Aon Center was the tallest building west of the Mississippi River when it was completed. It held this title until 1982. The building was later renamed First Interstate Tower before adopting its current name. The Aon Center is the third tallest building in Los Angeles and the fourth tallest in California. It is also notable for its resilience, being designed to withstand seismic activity, which is crucial in earthquake-prone Los Angeles. The building's history includes a significant fire in 1988, which led to changes in fire safety regulations for high-rise buildings in Los Angeles. Despite these challenges, the Aon Center remains a prominent feature of the city's skyline and a hub for business activities.

This 76-acre campus is designed to meet the growing demands of cloud service providers (CSPs) and high-performance computing (HPC) and AI data centers. The campus will feature a 92 MW data center facility, which will begin construction in 2025 and is expected to be fully operational by 2027. The Perseus facility exemplifies AVAIO Digital's commitment to sustainability, with over 90% of the grid power sourced from zero-carbon sources and 100% of its cooling and non-potable water needs met by recycled water. The facility will also incorporate on-site solar power and biofuels for its backup generators. Strategically located approximately 45 miles from San Francisco and 60 miles from Santa Clara, the AVAIO Pittsburg Campus offers a cost-competitive and sustainable alternative to data centers in the region. The project represents a significant investment in the community, with an estimated $800 million in development costs and promises substantial economic benefits for the City of Pittsburg and the greater East Bay.

addresses.name: Colovore SJC02
addresses.overviewHTML: Colovore 3060 Raymond St 95054 Santa Clara California, USA Colovore's SJC02 Data Center stands as a premier facility tailored for high-performance computing (HPC), artificial intelligence (AI), GPU servers, and big data workloads. Located in Santa Clara, it represents Colovore's second 9MW establishment in Silicon Valley, offering unparalleled standard power densities of 50 kW per cabinet, with customizable options reaching up to 250 kW per cabinet. Positioned at the heart of Silicon Valley, the center ensures easy accessibility for businesses operating within the region. Embracing liquid cooling for optimized performance, the SJC02 Data Center boasts robust cooling solutions, including rear door heat exchangers and direct liquid cooling (DLC) systems, catering to high-density equipment requirements. Certified by NVIDIA as DGX-Ready, the facility hosts approximately 1,000 DGX-1s and DGX-2s, highlighting its commitment to cutting-edge technologies. With each rack supporting an impressive 35 kW, the data center enables full packing and scalability of HPC infrastructure. Contiguous cabinets eliminate power, cooling, or distance constraints, ensuring optimal performance. Through densely packed racks, Colovore minimizes both capital expenditure (capex) and operating expenses (opex), delivering the lowest Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) while maximizing efficiency. Designed with future-proofing in mind, the SJC02 Data Center accommodates both current and future server needs without requiring additional space. Scalability is integral to its design, ensuring long-term viability. Boasting 9 MW of power, dual-fed by reliable Silicon Valley Power sources, the facility guarantees pristine power and reliability, experiencing zero downtime since its inception. With a decade-long legacy of delivering liquid-cooled, high-density colocation services, Colovore serves a diverse clientele ranging from Fortune 500 companies to startups, hosting the most advanced computing platforms in Silicon Valley.

addresses.name: SimpleNet Colo
addresses.overviewHTML: SimpleNet, Inc. 225 Broadway 92101 San Diego California, USA World-Class Data Center Our Data Center is a world-class facility, and the first of its kind in San Diego. Completed in March of 1998, our 2000 square-foot, 150 rack Data Center meets the high security and protection demands of any Internet presence. The SimpleNet Data Center has redundant systems for connectivity, electrical power, air conditioning and fire suppression to ensure that your Internet presence is always available. The SimpleNet Data Center is monitored 24 hours per day, 7 days per week and 365 days per year. Our staff is committed and trained to provide you with continual, high-level network monitoring and load management of your connection. In addition, we offer engineering support for outage response, network performance analysis and network planning. SimpleNet maintains connections to multiple upstream providers to provide redundancy and reliability for your connection to the Internet. These connections are multiple DS-3s (45Mb/s) with providers such as Sprint, Level3, MCI and XO Communications. SimpleNet optimizes the path your data takes so your customers don't have to wait. Network Operations Center (NOC) SimpleNet's NOC is manned 24 hours, 7 days a week 365 days a year. This provides continual, high-level SNMP monitoring and management of customer connections. In addition, the SimpleNet NOC offers engineering support for outage response, network performance analysis and planning. Environmental Systems The SimpleNet Data Center features a positive pressure, computer clean room with double filtration of fresh air before entering the center. In addition each air conditioner continuously filters the air within the room. The Data Center offers up to 60 tons of redundant air conditioning. Each of the 6 air conditioning units handles 10 tons of cooling capacity and is fully independent from other units. This allows maintenance to be performed or a failure of a unit without affecting your Internet presence. In order to provide optimum performance, the condensing units are located on the same floor as the Data Center and are vented outside through custom louvers designed specifically for SimpleNet. Inergen™ Fire Supression Inergen™ is an environmentally green, three-dimensional fire suppression agent. Inergen™ provides Data Centers with a non-water based agent that: * Is electrically nonconductive * Is safe for use in human occupied facilities * Does not damage sensitive electronic equipment * Has zero ozone depletion, zero global warming, and zero atmospheric lifetime Inergen™ is a blend of three naturally occurring gases – Nitrogen, Argon, and Carbon Dioxide. stored in cylinders within the Data Center. The Inergen™ system is like no other modern suppression system in use today. This system lowers the oxygen content of the room to a point sufficient to sustain human life, but insufficient to support combustion. Because its not a chemical agent, the Inergen™ gas will not produce a heavy fog the way other extinguishing agents do, so escape routes remain visible. The Inergen™ gas discharges through specially designed nozzles fitted with discharge deflectors so that turbulence is minimized. SimpleNet Power Grid The SimpleNet Data Center offers a robust, redundant power source. This redundancy starts with an APC Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) system that is made up of four 40 KVA units running in parallel for a total capacity of 160 KVA. Like the air conditioning systems any one of these units can be taken off line for maintenance without effecting the protection of the room. The UPS will carry the electrical load of the Data Center in the event of a power failure. Even under normal conditions each 20 amp circuit in the Data Center is UPS "conditioned" from the power sags and spikes that can occur with utility power. If any power failure last longer that a minute or so the SimpleNet 450 KW diesel generator will start up and supply the electrical load for as long as is necessary. This generator has a 240 gallon fuel tank that can be refueled from the street, indefinitely if the need arises.

addresses.name: SMS Datacenter
addresses.overviewHTML: SMS Datacenter 2525 Main Street Suite 120 92614 Irvine California, USA The SMS Datacenter located in Irvine, California was completely upgraded in 2009 as demand for capacity has increased for both power and cooling. The PUE (Power Utilization Efficiency) is always being reduced through technology upgrades. The facility meets the highest availability standards for housing mission critical computer systems, and is SOC2 audited annually. The purpose built facility contains a total area of 41,000 square feet and is a fully secure, disaster safe, state of the art steel structure with complete electrical, mechanical, and environmental back-up systems. The facility has power generation capability housing both internal and external diesel generators including three fully 2N redundant Powerware UPS systems. There is over 10,000 gallons of diesel fuel onsite providing over 72 hours at 100% load of up time. The Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS) are tested monthly, which can simulate the loss of utility power. The infrastructure includes a self-contained, automatically controlled environment maintained by over 6.5 million BTUs of air-cooled CRAC units with dedicated roof mounted condensers for the exclusive use of the raised floor. Each APC cabinet has three phase, 208 Volt redundant powers strips (PDUs) with both copper patch panels and fiber optic enclosures providing a redundant plug and play fabric. To prevent unauthorized entry to the facility, SMS Datacenter has 24x7 staff onsite, and a security system that controls access into and within the building, automatically limiting access to sensitive areas. Access is also logged automatically within a secure database. Additionally, cameras are installed both inside and outside the building with DVR recording. With displays in the fully manned Network Operation Center (NOC) and at the security desk, the premises are constantly monitored by a comprehensive security system. A uniform guard also operates security after business hours. There is infrastructure that can be brought online to provide an additional 2000 Amps of Power from a separate dual substation transformer feed with both generator paralleling gear and ATSs. Redundancy can also be achieved in cooling by bringing the existing redundant 270 ton cold water chillers online.

addresses.overviewHTML: H5 Data Centers 1625 Rockwell Ave 44114 Cleveland Ohio, USA H5's Cleveland Technology Center is a Tier III Enterprise Data Center with Carrier-Hotel Level Interconnection Opportunities H5's Cleveland data center is a state-of-the-art, 333,000 SF Tier III facility designed to provide high availability, industry-leading energy efficiency and physical security to its leading enterprise customers and the booming local Cleveland healthcare and biotechnology sectors. Further, the data center hosts several long haul fiber nodes for such communications providers as CenturyLink, XO Communications [now Verizon], Windstream and Zayo. Conveniently located in downtown Cleveland, H5's highly redundant Cleveland data center is in close proximity to the Central Business District (CBD) and interstate highways for easy access by local and out-of-market data center personnel. In fact, 60% of the US population is estimated to live within 600 miles of the data center. Centrally positioned between the Midwest and East Coast, the power grid serving Cleveland is not only one of the country's most reliable, but it's also one of the country's most affordable. The average annual cost per kWh is less than $0.06. The Cleveland data center is also one of two data centers in Ohio that is currently eligible for 100% sales and use tax abatement. The combination of the sales & use tax abatement and affordable power pricing make the Cleveland data center one of the most affordable locations in the US. Unique aspects of the Cleveland data center include: Cleveland Data Center 333,000 SF data center campus Private data center suites 24x7 on-site engineering and security teams Available office, staging, storage and conference room space Ample, on-site parking Covered loading dock bays to accommodate 18-wheel truck deliveries Scalable downtown Cleveland location Power The Illuminating Company (a FirstEnergy Company) provides the Cleveland data center with more than 10 MWs of redundant, reliable and affordable power (average annual costs per kWh of less than $0.06) from diverse substations. All systems are meticulously maintained by H5's 24x7 on-site Cleveland engineering team. H5's innovative electrical and mechanical architecture achieve up to 40% better energy efficiency than other data centers. The Cleveland data center was recently constructed with leading engineers and state-of-the-art equipment to ensure optimal energy utilization and reduced waste. Electrical and mechanical highlights include: Diverse utility feeds from The Illuminating Company's power grid Concurrently maintainable, Tier III data center design 2N UPS distribution 2N emergency generator farm designed for 48-hour runtime 2N chilled water system with economization Cabinet densities of more than 20 KWs per rack Customer monitoring of power usage Less than $0.06/kwh avg. annual power pricing from The Illuminating Company Security The Cleveland data center is a highly secure site to ensure regulatory compliance of its Fortune 500 customer and government tenant base. The Cleveland data center features 24x7 security staffing, biometric and keycard access systems, and digital security cameras. H5's security personnel are directly hired by H5 to promote personnel continuity, enforce strict training policies and maintain the highest level of standards. The data center offers the following security benefits: Biometric and key card access controls On-site digital cameras monitored 24x7 Dry-pipe pre-action and VESDA fire suppression system SSAE SOC 2 Type II certification Corporate-wide ISO 27001 compliance Certified tier III data center design and operation (TIA 942) Easy PCI compliance Network H5's Cleveland data center offers carrier-neutral colocation services, providing customers with access to a variety of different regional, national and international telecommunications carriers and fiber providers. Easily interconnect with your desired services provider via the H5-managed Meet-Me Room (MMR). With its carrier partners, H5 serves a growing community of enterprises, content delivery networks (CDNs) and cloud service providers seeking to improve their mission critical operations. Cleveland offers low latency to major population zones, including Ashburn/DC, Chicago, Detroit, New York, Philadelphia and Toronto. Highlights of H5's Cleveland network-neutral colocation facility include: Cleveland's carrier hotel Long haul access to each of CenturyLink, XO Communications [now Verizon], Windstream and Zayo Access to the region's top metro fiber and communications providers Over 10 metro networks to choose from Diverse fiber points of entry Cross connections available within 2 business days of order Features H5's Cleveland colocation facility is one of two colocation projects currently in the State of Ohio that are eligible for 100% sales & use tax abatement. Not only does this agreement apply to deployments today, but qualifying customers can be eligible for 100% sales & use tax abatement for more than a decade. Cleveland is one of the safest locations to site a colocation facility in the United States, as it is very unlikely to be affected by tornadoes, earthquakes, hurricanes, or flooding. In addition to being a safe location, the Cleveland colocation facility is also proximate to most of the country from a latency perspective as 60% of the US population is within 600 miles of the colocation facility. H5 regularly audits itself as part of SSAE SOC 1 Type II certifications and corporate-wide ISO 27001 compliance. The size of the Cleveland colocation facility allows for tremendous scale. H5 operates a 24x7 operations and engineering team on-site to monitor electrical & mechanical systems, perform remote hands and complete customer build-outs to the highest quality standards. H5's Cleveland data center product offering includes: 100% sales & use tax abatement on colocation equipments Turn-key wholesale colocation space Private colocation suites Private cages Powered shell build-outs Office and storage space 24x7remote hands services 100% uptime guarantee from H5

addresses.name: CBTS Hamilton Data Center
addresses.overviewHTML: CBTS 123 Pine St 45011 Hamilton Ohio, USA CBTS’ best-of-breed technology platforms enable our data center customers to enjoy on-demand dedicated or shared access to the following: Infrastructure Monitoring and Management Full outsourcing Enterprise Network Operations Center Tier 1 Service Desk Tier 2 Incident Management Advanced Engineering and Operations Tier 3 Incident Management Architecture and Design IT Governance Change Management Release Management Problem Management Companies like yours need stable and efficient facilities to operate their IT infrastructure at its best. This is what CBTS does best and this is our core competency.  Whether driven by compliance regulations, increased growth in data, additional communications platforms, physical and virtual security concerns, or stable environmentals to operate optimally….CBTS’ data center solutions are flexible enough to meet your requirements while providing cost-efficient and effective options.  For many, finding a data center provider is the solution; however, finding a provider with the power, space and bandwidth to meet your growing requirements is only half the battle. Today, CBTS owns and operates ten (10) geographically dispersed data centers in the Midwest. They are strategically positioned to leverage our own transport grid, redundant power, environmental and security platforms, allowing you to realize the benefits of a hardened data center without the burden of capital expenditures. Available services and features: Bandwidth Being a subsidiary of Cincinnati Bell is an advantage because of the variety of bandwidth and connectivity options we can offer our clients.  Cincinnati Bell has peering agreements with all major telecommunications carriers, providing our customers flat rate bandwidth options ranging from DSx – OCx speeds, to tiered burstable connectivity from Level 3's IP backbone (56k – 20MB/s speeds). CBTS also has an additional and unique transport option – a DWDM fiber loop that connects all our ten (10) data centers; this high-speed loop facilitates a number of business continuity and disaster recovery options not available from other data center providers anywhere in the country. Power CBTS data centers have 100% redundancy capabilities throughout our power delivery system. This means our data centers have dispersed power grid feeds to separate power connections into the cabinet.  Power enters the building from two separate power grids provided by the public utility company.  Power inside the facility is provided to each individual cabinet supplied by separate power feeds from disparate UPS systems. If a power outage is sensed by our detection systems, the battery portion of the system kicks in immediately and within one minute, the backup generators come on line to provide full backup power to the data center. This process is transparent to all customer equipment in the facility, while ensure that no device is affected by the outage.  In addition, all customer cabinets are grounded and protected by anti-static mats and floor tiles. This is fully tested and certified by a third party testing service. Environmentals CBTS data centers have N+1 redundancy capability for all environmental controls. Temperature and humidity are continuously monitored and controlled via multiple sensors to maintain air temperature between 70 – 74 degrees and relative humidity between 40% – 60%.  Each unit has a data interface board that reports the environmental status and all alarms to the building’s environmental management system, which is monitored 24x7.  CBTS also has a state-of-the-art fire suppression system, VESDA (Very Early Smoke Detection System Appliance) proactively monitors for smoke and fires.  Once VESDA detects particles or smoke in the air, it immediately notifies the ENOC at the data center and the personnel staff will immediately see the alert. All CBTS facilities are meshed for monitoring purposes. Security CBTS employs a seven (7) tier security approach to ensure your data is safe.  All our data centers are well-secured environments, including the 24x7 presence of guards, closed-circuit TV monitoring, electronic card-key access, and a host of access procedures that ensures unauthorized parties cannot access our client’s IT equipment. Our data center facilities are also structurally sound and capable of protecting your IT infrastructure in the event of a disaster.  In fact, the Cincinnati Data Center was built in 1930 and is dramatically over-engineered, according to the Bell System standards for disaster protection. The building features a triple wall construction that includes an outer layer of brick, inner layer of 12” re-enforced concrete, and another inner layer of brick. It also has a unique “flexible” foundation designed to absorb the movement of the earth in the highly unlikely event of an earthquake. Compliance All CBTS data centers are subject to an annual SAS 70 Type II audit, and this compliance verification report is available in hardcopy to CBTS' data center customers as needed.  Every three calendar years, CBTS has a "HIPAA Compliance" audit performed during that year's SAS 70 audit.  The additional HIPAA audit testing covers CBTS' obligations as a "Business Associate" to protect customer PHI per the Privacy and Security Regulations. addresses.name: Telesystem DC-1
addresses.overviewHTML: Buckeye Telesystem, Inc 4818 Angola Road 43615 Toledo Ohio, USA Telesystem I is a world class data center meeting industry standards such as the Uptime Institute’s Tier III and Tier IV standards for structure and mechanicals.  In addition, Telesystem I voluntarily undertook and passed a SSAE SOC 16 Type I attestation for Security and Availability principles.  We believe we are the only Data Center in the area with SSAE SOC 2 attestation. The facility itself, housed within the network operations center, showcases the Telesystem standard for exceeding normal data center specifications.  For starters, Telesytem looked at the specifications to withstand an E-F-5 tornado…  and doubled them….effectively giving Telesystem a network operations center with walls over one foot thick. Once complete, we topped off the structure with a solid, concrete roof. The structure also features state of the art cooling and power capabilities. In row, chilled water cooling and air purifying equipment are monitored 24x7x365 using struxureware….ensuring Telesystem I is running at optimum environmental conditions. Each cabinet comes standard with an uniterruptable power supply with modular-based batteries ensures a 625 KVA, fully redundant power supply. All cabinet rows have redundant, state of the art modular power distribution units or pdu’s, allowing for easy “plug and play” replacement of breakers, along with a dedicated 1600 amp power supply. For electrical outages Telesystem’s 1875 kva emergency generators ensure that power remains constant in case of a short-term electricity outage. For connectivity, Telesystem offers both public and private options. addresses.name: CBTS Mason Data Center
addresses.overviewHTML: CBTS 784 Forrest Hill St. 45040 Mason Ohio, USA CBTS’ best-of-breed technology platforms enable our data center customers to enjoy on-demand dedicated or shared access to the following: Infrastructure Monitoring and Management Full outsourcing Enterprise Network Operations Center Tier 1 Service Desk Tier 2 Incident Management Advanced Engineering and Operations Tier 3 Incident Management Architecture and Design IT Governance Change Management Release Management Problem Management Companies like yours need stable and efficient facilities to operate their IT infrastructure at its best. This is what CBTS does best and this is our core competency.  Whether driven by compliance regulations, increased growth in data, additional communications platforms, physical and virtual security concerns, or stable environmentals to operate optimally….CBTS’ data center solutions are flexible enough to meet your requirements while providing cost-efficient and effective options.  For many, finding a data center provider is the solution; however, finding a provider with the power, space and bandwidth to meet your growing requirements is only half the battle. Today, CBTS owns and operates ten (10) geographically dispersed data centers in the Midwest. They are strategically positioned to leverage our own transport grid, redundant power, environmental and security platforms, allowing you to realize the benefits of a hardened data center without the burden of capital expenditures. Available services and features: Bandwidth Being a subsidiary of Cincinnati Bell is an advantage because of the variety of bandwidth and connectivity options we can offer our clients.  Cincinnati Bell has peering agreements with all major telecommunications carriers, providing our customers flat rate bandwidth options ranging from DSx – OCx speeds, to tiered burstable connectivity from Level 3's IP backbone (56k – 20MB/s speeds). CBTS also has an additional and unique transport option – a DWDM fiber loop that connects all our ten (10) data centers; this high-speed loop facilitates a number of business continuity and disaster recovery options not available from other data center providers anywhere in the country. Power CBTS data centers have 100% redundancy capabilities throughout our power delivery system. This means our data centers have dispersed power grid feeds to separate power connections into the cabinet.  Power enters the building from two separate power grids provided by the public utility company.  Power inside the facility is provided to each individual cabinet supplied by separate power feeds from disparate UPS systems. If a power outage is sensed by our detection systems, the battery portion of the system kicks in immediately and within one minute, the backup generators come on line to provide full backup power to the data center. This process is transparent to all customer equipment in the facility, while ensure that no device is affected by the outage.  In addition, all customer cabinets are grounded and protected by anti-static mats and floor tiles. This is fully tested and certified by a third party testing service. Environmentals CBTS data centers have N+1 redundancy capability for all environmental controls. Temperature and humidity are continuously monitored and controlled via multiple sensors to maintain air temperature between 70 – 74 degrees and relative humidity between 40% – 60%.  Each unit has a data interface board that reports the environmental status and all alarms to the building’s environmental management system, which is monitored 24x7.  CBTS also has a state-of-the-art fire suppression system, VESDA (Very Early Smoke Detection System Appliance) proactively monitors for smoke and fires.  Once VESDA detects particles or smoke in the air, it immediately notifies the ENOC at the data center and the personnel staff will immediately see the alert. All CBTS facilities are meshed for monitoring purposes. Security CBTS employs a seven (7) tier security approach to ensure your data is safe.  All our data centers are well-secured environments, including the 24x7 presence of guards, closed-circuit TV monitoring, electronic card-key access, and a host of access procedures that ensures unauthorized parties cannot access our client’s IT equipment. Our data center facilities are also structurally sound and capable of protecting your IT infrastructure in the event of a disaster.  In fact, the Cincinnati Data Center was built in 1930 and is dramatically over-engineered, according to the Bell System standards for disaster protection. The building features a triple wall construction that includes an outer layer of brick, inner layer of 12” re-enforced concrete, and another inner layer of brick. It also has a unique “flexible” foundation designed to absorb the movement of the earth in the highly unlikely event of an earthquake. Compliance All CBTS data centers are subject to an annual SAS 70 Type II audit, and this compliance verification report is available in hardcopy to CBTS' data center customers as needed.  Every three calendar years, CBTS has a "HIPAA Compliance" audit performed during that year's SAS 70 audit.  The additional HIPAA audit testing covers CBTS' obligations as a "Business Associate" to protect customer PHI per the Privacy and Security Regulations. Cloud Computing Cincinnati Bell N + N redundant network Private partition in a CBTS data center Private extension of your network Specify and use your own IP addressing Layer 2 or Layer 3 agnostic connectivity via private circuit, MPLS, VPN, or Metro Ethernet Virtual Data Center appears as a site on your private network Web portal to configure and deploy your servers on demand, 24x7

addresses.name: NetSource Naperville 1
addresses.overviewHTML: NetSource Communications, Inc. 2368 Corporate Lane Suite 112 60563 Naperville Illinois, USA NetSource is a full service datacenter providing Chicago and Chicago suburbs with enterprise hosting services.  NetSource's datacenter is located in Naperville, IL with additional cage space in Chicago.  NetSource has been in business since 1995 and is a full SSAE16 Type 2 hosting facility.  NetSource works with small, medium, and companies as large as Fortune 500. NetSource offers colocation rack space (single U, 1/3 rack, 1/2 rack, full racks), and other managed hosting services including custom dedicated hardware like private cloud setups.  NetSource can rent rack space month to month or with longer terms for additional savings. Overview NetSource is a Chicago area (Naperville, IL) hosting company that owns and operates a world class datacenter. NetSource hired an engineering company specializing in the construction of ANSI / TIA 942 datacenters to build the center described in this document. This provided NetSource a unique opportunity to build the center from the ground up according to the most recent standards available. In particular NetSource referred to the ANSI/TIA 942 standard for datacenters, the only approved standard in existence at the time of construction, PCI-DSS standards for security, and most recently SSAE16 Type 2 / SAS70 Type 2 compliance. These standards call for rigorous procedures in all facets of datacenter operation. Plus, we were able to leverage 17 years of experience in the Internet business. The current SSAE16 Type 2 audit verifies and tests our operations and procedures to conform to the highest standards. See the NetSource engagement letter from The Moore Group that specializes in SSAE16/SAS70 audits of datacenters for more information. The audit report is available to a customer's auditors upon request. Security Security is one of the most important aspects of datacenter operation to NetSource and its customers. NetSource provides a secure facility that has passed, first time, many customer audits. NetSource maintains a security policy according to the PCI-DSS standard. NetSource provides locked access to the building and to the main datacenter. Only qualified staff are allowed in the datacenter. NetSource provides video surveillance throughout the facility and stores digital video for at least 120 days. Customers are required to read and sign data center procedures before NetSource allows entry to the datacenter. NetSource enforces sign-in procedures and logs all entry to datacenter rooms electronically. Once inside the datacenter all server and network equipment is in closed and locked cabinets, there are no open racks. NetSource secures critical networks with firewalls and/or intrusion detection systems. Special software monitors the logs from firewall and IDS systems to report events that need attention. This is a brief summary of the security procedures enforced at NetSource. See the data center specifications for more information. Reliability Reliability is another key goal of the NetSource datacenter. NetSource considers itself a tier 3 datacenter according to the uptime institute definitions. Measured uptime of the NetSource backbone network over the last four years is 99.997%. Achieving this uptime over a long four year period is due to NetSource's knowledge, network architecture, and procedures. NetSource maintains at least an N+1 architecture in power, cooling, and networking. NetSource utilizes physically diverse Internet connections and network entry points into the building. The APC UPSs are configured as N+1 with automatic bypass and with generator backup. The generator(s) also support the cooling systems. The computer room air conditioners are maintained with N+1 redundancy and maintain the room at the temperatures and humidity required by the ANSI 942 standard. Customers have the option to connect to the NetSource backbone with redundant network connections and use redundant A/B power going through separate circuit breakers for the highest level of reliability all the way to the customer's equipment. Performance To keep peak performance, NetSource uses full 10 gigabit per second fiber connections to the Internet and supports at least gigabit speeds in its backbone network. Customers have the option to connect to the backbone at 1 gbps, 100 mbps, 10 mbps, or custom speeds as needed. NetSource monitors its connections for low packet loss and low latencies and provides appropriate SLAs to customers to ensure high performance. Packet loss is effectively zero with latencies in the backbone on less than 1 millisecond. NetSource also monitors connections on the general Internet to make sure its Internet providers continue with a high performance service. Key destinations around the USA are measured between 20 and 30 milliseconds on average. Maintenance and Monitoring NetSource constantly monitors and maintains its datacenter. Every piece of equipment has a maintenance plan. All key networking elements including routers, firewalls, CRACs, UPSs, servers are monitored by automated systems that send alerts on failure. This includes customer's network connections and optionally their systems. NetSource has contracts with third party vendors to maintain certain equipment like CRACs, generators, and fire suppression systems. NetSource has documented emergency recovery procedures that cover every kind of datacenter failure and it focuses first on prevention. NetSource uses redundant systems to keep mean time to failure low. NetSource keeps spare equipment for fast repairs to keep mean time to repair low. See the data center specifications for more information. Summary This document has provided a brief summary of some of the key elements of the NetSource datacenter specifications and procedures. This document is not intended to provide all information regarding procedures but provides enough information to give the overview. For more information, see the other documents that NetSource provides publicly as listed below. •Data center procedures for working in an active data center, for customers •Acceptable use policies •Data center specifications •SSAE16 Type II / SAS70 Type II audit report •The NetSource website at http://www.ntsource.com NetSource owns and operates our own Chicago area datacenter providing us complete control over the quality of the hosting service we provide. NetSource can host your web site, business application, and mission critical data in our state-of-the-art data center. You will get the highest reliability and performance with 100% network availability including our redundant gigabit fiber bandwidth connections to the Internet. Please review our data center specifications below and see why our Chicagoland (Naperville) data center has some of the highest customer ratings in the midwest.
